d: Hello again, this is Dual writing a quick message once more. ADATA, part of the memory cartel, is not wanting to respond to my warranty claim due to a faulty NVMe, something that, of course, I expected. Still, I'm running out of storage, and to finish things up, Photoshop decided that I can't have a credits page; if I have the audacity to create one, it will corrupt it, so here I am, using other software for it. I also started learning InDesign for typesetting and Illustrator for titles, so there might be some errors here and there; my workflow these past two months has changed a lot. There are two BA projects currently in production; one is Kikyou (キキョウの浮気調査), and the other one is Kayoko (カヨコとセックスする本!). This will take some time since both are full SFX. Anyway, I hope you enjoy it.
